source.title: National Heritage List for England (NHLE) - Listed Building polygons layer, exact record 1223756
source.source_window_hash_basis: canonical observed official API-catalogue/layer-schema and NHLE record text plus exact-query retrieval failure; not raw FeatureServer response bytes

evidence_slice: Historic England's official NHLE record identifies Roman Catholic Church of the Sacred Heart, South Street, Exeter, List Entry 1223756, Grade II, with explicit church building identity/type and most recent amendment dated 18 October 2013. The GOV.UK API Catalogue identifies Historic England's official National Heritage List for England FeatureServer and its Listed Building polygons layer (layer 3), whose schema binds Polygon geometry with ListEntry, Name and Grade. A distinct exact-record GeoJSON request for ListEntry 1223756 with returnGeometry=true could not be retrieved through the available web channel, and direct network resolution of the official ArcGIS host failed before any feature payload was read. No polygon coordinates were inferred or fabricated.

field_evidence.footprint: Official layer 3 is esriGeometryPolygon and binds ListEntry/Name/Grade, but the exact ListEntry 1223756 GeoJSON feature response was not retrievable; no Polygon/MultiPolygon coordinates were read.
field_evidence.type_use: Official NHLE record explicitly identifies Roman Catholic Church of the Sacred Heart; summary states Roman Catholic Church of 1883-4.
field_evidence.identity: Official NHLE List Entry 1223756, Grade II, statutory address South Street, Exeter; most recent amendment 18 October 2013.
